originalTitle: Christmas Everyday: Married and Bright | Official Trailer (Brandy x Lifetime, 2026)
content: In this sequel to 2025's 'Christmas Everyday,' Chicago fashion designer Fancy Ballantine (Brandy Norwood) is preparing for the biggest season of her life as she works to secure the future of her thriving boutique while planning her dream Christmas wedding to her fiancé, Jaylen (Robert C. Riley). With her supportive mother Evelyn (Debbi Morgan), and spirited sister Belle (Brandy's real-life daughter, Sy'rai Smith) by her side, everything seems to be falling into place. But when mounting business pressures and the unexpected return of a reformed ex lead Fancy to shoulder every burden on her own, she unintentionally pushes Jaylen away. As Christmas approaches, Fancy must decide whether she's willing to let go of the past before it costs her the future she's always dreamed of. Also returning to reprise their roles are Kajuana S. Marie as Deena, Journey Carter as Tia, Jeffrey Bowyer-Chapman as Germaine, and Lamman Rucker as Richard. Gregory Alan Williams joins the cast as Earl. 'Christmas Everyday: Married and Bright ' premieres Saturday, Nov. 28, at 8 p.m. ET/PT on Lifetime, as part of the network's It's a Wonderful Lifetime series.
